title: A Prompt Array Keeps the Bias Away: Debiasing Vision-Language Models with Adversarial Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-image retrieval ranking metrics (MaxSkew, NDKL) and Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) scores on face image datasets (FairFace, UTKFace) using text queries populated with neutral, positive, and negative adjectives.

Measuring text-image similarity ranking metrics (MaxSkew, NDKL) and calculating harmful zero-shot misclassification rates to evaluate how often faces from different ethnic groups are erroneously mapped to criminal or non-human text concepts.
